guide_solution: (a) In recent years, there have been many alarming reports that the world temperatures are increasing day by day. (b) This increase in global warming is caused by increased amounts of carbon dioxide around the earth. (c) Most climatologists believe that greenhouse effect is an important cause of global warming. (d) Again, the main culprit for global warming is carbon dioxide gas which is produced by the burning of fossils fuels and forest. (e) We should take necessary steps as early as possible in order to save the existence of living animals on earth.
